title: What a local client writes to a run: recorded steps, repairs, repeats and field errors
description: Rules for the write routes a local client drives: the trace post, the completion, the finding create and the errors of all of them. Each rule is behind a capability. A client sends recorded steps only when pickup lists recorded_steps_v1 in server_capabilities. A client that sends guidance_default_v1 or strict_fields_v1 in protocol_capabilities at pickup gets the default guidance basis and the strict field check. A client sends a completion dry run only when pickup lists completion_repairs_v1 in server_capabilities, because a server without it would ignore dry_run and complete the run. The repairs of a blocked completion, idempotency keys and field paths in type errors need no capability: an older client never sends them and never sees them.
x-guidance: A recorded step is a trace step a hook of the client wrote down as a tool ran, with recorded_by set to client. Send the tool name, the input, the status and the times. Do not send guidance, outcome, cause_key or reuse_hint with it: the server refuses them on a recorded step and stores the basis system_recorded.

When the model has read the result of a recorded step, post a trace step with the same step_id and no recorded_by. That post adds the outcome, the cause_key and the guidance. The recorded title, tool, input, result and times stay as the hook wrote them.

A run keeps 200 recorded steps. After that a new recorded step is answered with 200, an empty steps list and a note with the code recorded_step_limit, and is not stored. This is not an error: a hook must not fail a tool call because of it. Steps the model posts are still stored.
With guidance_default_v1 a trace step with no guidance gets the basis agent_judgment with the step title as the reason. Send guidance only when a runbook or a responder guided the check.

Before you complete a run, and only when pickup lists completion_repairs_v1, send the completion with dry_run true. The server runs every completion rule, writes nothing and answers with ready and one list of repairs. Each repair has a code, the field path, what is missing and one example of a valid value. Fix every repair, then send the same body without dry_run.
A completion the runbook coverage blocks answers 422 investigation_completion_blocked with the coverage and the same repairs list. Read repairs first; coverage is the detail behind it.

Send an Idempotency-Key header (or the idempotency_key field) with every finding. Use one new key for one finding, for example a UUID, and send the same key when you repeat the request after a timeout. The repeat answers 200 with the first finding and the header Idempotent-Replayed: true, and creates nothing.

A cause upsert is safe to repeat: the cause key in the path is its identity. A trace step is safe to repeat by its step_id. A create of a run with an id you chose is safe to repeat: when the run exists and you made it in the same incident, the answer is 200 with that run.

A value of the wrong type answers 400 invalid_field_type with field set to the path of the value, for example result_summary.causal_paths[0].steps[1].finding_ids, and a message that says which type the field wants. Correct that field and send the request again.

With strict_fields_v1 a body with a field the route does not know answers 400 unknown_field. field is the first path and details.fields lists up to 20 of them. Remove or rename those fields. Without the capability unknown fields are dropped with no message, as before.

repairs.missing: A confirmed or likely diagnosis needs the causal chain: one path with one or more steps, each citing the findings that prove it.
